info.name: Bank platform: personal loans (local)
info.description: Run the folders in order. Everything runs against local services and a provider SIMULATOR; no real money, customer or provider is involved. See README.md next to this file. Saved example responses were recorded from a real local run on 2026-10-01.

item.name: 1. Onboarding (identity service)
item.description: Register a customer (the BVN is verified by an HTTP call to the provider simulator) and sign in.

request.description: No auth. A random phone and BVN are generated by the pre-request script. The last four digits of the BVN select the simulator's behaviour: 0000 not found, 1111 mismatch, 9999 timeout, 8888 malformed, 7777 HTTP 500, anything else match.

response.name: 409 (recorded from a local run)
400 (recorded from a local run)
422 (recorded from a local run)

request.description: Five wrong PINs lock the credential for 15 minutes (enforced in PostgreSQL). Run this once only.
Returns a 15-minute access token. Run it again if later requests return 401.

item.name: 2. Application and decision
item.description: Submit an application (T0) and wait for the decision (T1).

response.name: 400 (recorded from a local run)

request.description: 202: the application is stored and assessed asynchronously (KYC, fraud screen, credit bureau, policy).

response.name: 422 (recorded from a local run)

request.description: 201 with status ACTIVE means the ledger posted the disbursement. 202 with DISBURSING means the posting is durable but the ledger did not answer in time; it completes in the background and GET loan shows it.

exec: pm.test('loan is active (the ledger has posted)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ACTIVE'));

item.name: Repay: retry with the same key
5. Repayment from outside the bank (payment verification)
item.description: The customer pays through a payment provider. Nothing is credited until lending has asked the provider about the payment itself.

exec: // The simulator's webhook signature: hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<body>".
const body = JSON.stringify({event_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), type: 'payment.updated', reference: pm.collectionVariables.get('payment_reference')});

item.name: Payment webhook: signed, but nothing was paid

request.description: A correctly signed webhook is accepted (200) but credits nothing: lending asks the provider, which has no such payment.

exec: // The simulator's webhook signature: hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<body>".
const body = JSON.stringify({event_id: pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'), type: 'payment.updated', reference: pm.collectionVariables.get('payment_reference')});

item.name: SIMULATOR: customer pays at the provider

request.description: This is the SIMULATOR, not lending. It stands in for the provider's checkout page and then sends lending the signed webhook a real provider would send.

exec: else { pm.test('applied to the loan', () => pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('APPLIED')); pm.test('credited what the provider collected', () => pm.expect(p.received_minor).to.eql(500000)); }
